mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies at 61 degrees near Badger Ridge Middle School, with the moon currently in its first quarter phase.

The City of Verona is beginning an 18 month process to update its Comprehensive Plan, which serves as a long term guide for growth, housing, and infrastructure. Residents are encouraged to visit the Envision Verona website to participate in the planning process. Additionally, the city is encouraging residents to sign up for the digital newsletter to stay informed on local projects and programs.

There is plenty to do in our area. Today, you can enjoy yoga at Insight Wellness or participate in trivia at Hop Haus. Tomorrow, live music returns to Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, the Sugar River Fire and Smoke BBQ Festival begins this Friday, followed by the Dane County Farmer's Market and Bike the Barns this Saturday.

In a report on notable police activity, officers responded to a call on September 3 where a 33 year old Madison man was arrested for O W I, second offence, after a vehicle crash on Shooting Star Road.
Culver's of Verona will open today at 10:00 AM. Please note that the flavor of the day is currently unavailable as the store is closed for a remodel.
